title: Mantel and trim.
officialText: Woodwork or other combustible materials shall not be placed within 6 inches (152 mm) of a fire- place opening. Combustible material within 12 inches (305 mm) of the fireplace opening shall not project more than 1/8 inch (3.2 mm) for each 1-inch (25 mm) distance from such opening.
